name: Ciruelos de Cervera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, pale yellow and green with a broad middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ciruelos de Cervera (a tree and a stag on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Ciruelos de Cervera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ciruelos de Cervera arms — tree and stag
